name: Ane Tsumami ~Miwaku no Osananajimi Onee-san Hitozuma to no Mecha Ero Dousei LoveLife~
original_name: あねつまみ ～魅惑の幼なじみお姉さん人妻とのめちゃエロ同棲LoveLife～
source:
The protagonist, Igawa Haruhiro, moves in with his aunt and uncle while attending cram school.
Just as he’s settling into his new life, his uncle is transferred for work, leaving him alone with his beloved aunt, Shion. Her overprotective nature and unconscious allure start stirring up feelings he can’t ignore. To make things more complicated, his childhood crush, Rena, also moves in.
Now living with two married women he adores, Haruhiro finds himself pampered, teased, and drawn into a steamy cohabitation life full of love and mischief!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01000200.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
男主角Igawa Haruhiro为了上补习班，搬去和叔叔、婶婶同住。

新生活才刚安顿下来，叔叔就因工作调动离开了，留下他和心爱的婶婶Shion独处。婶婶对他保护过度，又浑然不觉自己散发着魅力，令他无法忽视心中渐起的情愫。事情还不止如此，他儿时暗恋的Rena也搬了进来。

如今和两位自己倾心的已婚女性同住，Haruhiro被她们宠爱、逗弄，卷入一段充满爱意与嬉闹的火热同居生活！
